channel.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK vs the World
channel.desc: It's back and fiercer than ever! The hugely successful Drag Race UK spin-off returns as RuPaul welcomes elite queens from across the Drag Race world to the UK arena. In this premiere, the queens launch into the Ruruvision Song Contest - a glittering celebration where each queen represents their home franchise on the international stage - complete with cheeky VO from Graham Norton. Two-time Eurovision winner Loreen joins RuPaul on the judging panel alongside Michelle Visage and Graham.
